pathway_track_mapping_contract.candidate_evidence_rule: The Ministry combination strings are evidence candidates only and do not establish a canonical-subject relationship.

mapping_record_schema.relationship_id_rule: SHA-256 of capture_id, canonicalId, pathway, track, and immutable source-evidence identity separated by NUL bytes.

pathway_track_mapping_contract.unresolved_scope: Every registry subject absent from confirmed_mappings.
prohibited_derivations: Do not derive pathway or track membership from sourceCategory.
Do not derive pathway or track membership from presence in a subjects_in_combinations union.
Do not confirm a mapping from exact-name uniqueness or fuzzy alias similarity alone.

publication_policy.catalog_only_output: May retain null pathway and track values while explicitly preserving unresolved status.
publication_policy.pathway_enriched_output: Only confirmed mappings may emit pathway or track claims.

capture_invariants.page_count_verification_method: Read the live Drive preview itemJson, follow its signed viewer/upload bootstrap, then read the integer pages field from the corresponding viewer/meta JSON response.
capture_invariants.filename_verification_method: Read the official filename from the live Drive preview og:title/itemJson metadata.
capture_invariants.pathway_verification_method: Read the pathway and track hierarchy from the Ministry of Education Pathways page and the combination counts and subject strings from its live public API.
